sections.Profile:
The Casanova pinball machine, produced by Williams Electronic Games in November 1966, was designed by the iconic Steve Kordek with artwork by Christian Marche.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1966
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Historical Figure, Two player, Travel, Backbox Gimmick, Original Theme, Single level playfield, Romance
